result_boundary: backend-native: DDC/WAH/EWAH COMP_op; CRoaring COMP_op_native; no dense delivery
limitations: Same-column equality operands make literal COMP reduce to NOT B for C>=3; the C=2 case reduces to NOT (A OR B).
DDC uses the existing default decompressed mixed-result path; CRoaring, WAH, and EWAH retain compressed native results.
DDC includes destruction of one local intermediate before the timer stops; the other backends destroy intermediates afterward.
